video.title: 40 Ways to Make $400,000 from Unwanted Land

summary: Chris Koerner presents dozens of ways to earn money from unwanted or underused land, using examples from his property and businesses he has seen. Ideas range from camping, storage and rentals to food, trees, construction, equipment and land resale. He repeatedly recommends testing demand before making large investments, using existing marketplaces, and finding ways to repurpose low-cost assets. Many examples are US-specific, rely on physical work, or are anecdotes about other operators rather than independently verified results.
